exact_glosses: ["The most abundant mineral on the earth's surface, of chemical composition silicon dioxide, SiO₂. It occurs in a variety of forms, both crystalline and amorphous. Found in every environment."]
wording: Quartz is the most common mineral on Earth’s surface, made of silicon dioxide (SiO₂). It appears in many crystalline and amorphous shapes and can be found almost anywhere.

exact_glosses: ["A device for transmitting conversations and other sounds in real time across distances, now often a small portable unit also capable of running software etc."]
wording: A device that lets people talk and share sounds instantly over a distance, usually small enough to carry around and often able to run software.

exact_glosses: ["A kind of cage inserted in a stuffing box and surrounding a piston rod, to separate the packing into two parts and form a chamber between for the reception of steam, etc.; a lantern brass."]
wording: A cage used in a stuffing box around a piston rod to separate packing and create a chamber for steam or similar fluids; also called lantern brass.

exact_glosses: ["Aristotle's lantern"]
wording: A specialized feeding structure found in certain marine animals, notably sea urchins, that is sometimes referred to as Aristotle's lantern.
